name: Pipeline for uploading new Reference BRS-SRS-SDS specs to KBs

parameters.subject: ={{ '[Cognia Reference KB] Upload Failure - ' + ($json.spec_name || 'Unknown Document') }}
parameters.text:
={{
  'Cognia KB Pipeline - Upload Failure Notification

' +
  'An error occurred while processing a specification document.

' +
  'Pipeline: ' + ($json.pipeline_id || 'N/A') + '
' +
  'Document: ' + ($json.spec_name || 'N/A') + '
' +
  'Document Type: ' + ($json.document_type || 'N/A') + '
' +
  'Status: ' + ($json.status || 'N/A') + '
' +
  'Commit ID: ' + ($json.commit_id || 'N/A') + '
' +
  'File Path: ' + ($json.spec_path || 'N/A') + '
' +
  'Error Details: ' + ($json.error_message || 'N/A') + '
' +
  'Timestamp: ' + ($json.processed_at || $now.toISO()) + '

' +
  'Please review the n8n execution logs and audit table.

' +
  'This is an automated notification from Cognia KB Pipeline.'
}}
